title: Employment transition of loan originators.
bodyText: In anticipation of satisfying all licensure requirements set out in part I, an individual shall be deemed to have temporary authority to act as a mortgage loan originator in this State as provided by and subject to the requirements of this part.
bodyHtml: [§454F-52]  Employment transition of loan originators.  In anticipation of satisfying all licensure requirements set out in part I, an individual shall be deemed to have temporary authority to act as a mortgage loan originator in this State as provided by and subject to the requirements of this part. [L 2019, c 74, pt of §1]
